nodes.description: Public token name string set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the constructor.
Public uint8 decimals value set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, initialized to 1e30 in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances; mutated by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) holding allowances; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
ZOOT constructor: sets name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and credits the deployer balance.
View function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Debits msg.sender and credits 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd, emits Transfer.
Debits 'from', decrements allowance of msg.sender and credits 'to' via safeSub/safeAdd.
SafeMath addition with overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath subtraction with underflow require(b <= a).
SafeMath multiplication with overflow check; unused by ZOOT.
SafeMath division with zero-divisor check; unused by ZOOT.
Caller-controlled address used as balance/allowance key and as the debited account in transfers.
balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply state write in the constructor.
allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens state write in approve.
balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] state writes in transfer.
balances[from], allowed[from][msg.sender] and balances[to] state writes in transferFrom.
approve() parameter used as the allowance mapping key.
approve() parameter set as the raw allowance amount without validation.
transfer() recipient address credited via safeAdd.
transfer() amount subtracted from the caller via safeSub.
transferFrom() source address debited via safeSub.
transferFrom() recipient address credited via safeAdd.
transferFrom() amount subtracted from source and allowance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mapping key that receives the entire initial supply.
allowance is written for the caller's account keyed by msg.sender.
The caller's own balance is debited based on msg.sender.
The spender allowance consumed is keyed by msg.sender inside transferFrom.
The constructor body executes the initial balance write.
_totalSupply value flows into the initial balances write.
Constructor assigns the constant total supply.
approve executes the allowance state write.
transfer executes the balance state writes.
transferFrom executes the balance and allowance state writes.
transfer delegates the debit arithmetic to safeSub.
transfer delegates the credit arithmetic to safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates debit arithmetic to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates credit arithmetic to safeAdd.
transfer requires safeSub to succeed before committing balances.
transferFrom requires safeSub to succeed before committing balances.
Initial supply write targets the balances mapping.
approve write targets the allowed mapping.
transfer writes into the balances mapping.
transferFrom writes into the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
spender parameter is the second key of the allowance write.
tokens parameter becomes the stored allowance value.
recipient address receives the credited amount through safeAdd.
transfer amount is the subtrahend passed to safeSub.
from address is the key debited in transferFrom.
to address is credited in transferFrom through safeAdd.
tokens amount is subtracted from source and allowance via safeSub.

normalization_plan.reason: The spender parameter only exists to key the allowance write performed by approve.
The tokens parameter has no independent behaviour; it is stored directly by the approve allowance write.
The recipient parameter is only meaningful as the credit target inside transfer.
The amount parameter is consumed by the transfer balance mutation.
The source parameter is only used to read and debit the balance inside transferFrom.
The recipient parameter exists only as the credited key of the transferFrom balance write.
The amount parameter is consumed by the transferFrom balance and allowance mutations.
